name: s81engm_shcolb
why_floorplan: banded MIX4 shell payload column (shcol + own-column issue valid iv/ph, +2 FF): same 164.16 x 54 outline as the closed shcol; faces swapped for the banded cluster column (VM side S toward the cluster transport channel, cluster side N toward add8/mul4 above); 4 per cluster x 4 clusters (replaces ot_s81_engram_mixq_shcol, no added master count)
structural_change: S-ENGRAM+NORM MIX4-PARENT 10-16: the shell control iv/phase broadcast to 8 mul4 + 4 add8 (frozen R0 screen: -147 ps worst, 5+4+1+1 negative fan-out joins) is replaced by each payload column issuing its own column valid from the registered load decision it already makes (iv = ld_r|ld_a, ph = ld_a, same edge as h/kv/w): 0 cycles, exact. The load decision uses the captured return-valid pattern alone (REDUCE = 11111, ADD = 00111; the shell control faults on any other), so the fr/fa phase-flag inputs (and their 8 long control joins per cluster) are removed.
